fields.name: watch_terms
fields.label: Watch terms
fields.help: Names or registration numbers to look for in each edition, one per item. Case, accents and repeated spaces do not matter. In the hub's .env file, separate them with commas.

fields.name: check_interval_minutes
fields.label: Check interval (minutes)
fields.help: Time from the end of one check of the gazette to the start of the next. Decimals are allowed.

fields.name: start_after
fields.label: Start after
fields.help: Used only on the first start, while the database is empty: editions published earlier are skipped. A date (2026-11-01) or a timestamp (2026-11-01T08:30:00, UTC unless it carries a zone). Empty means 72 hours before that first start.

fields.name: database_url
fields.label: Database address
fields.help: Postgres address, password included. The monitor connects without TLS. Another database starts from scratch with a new welcome alert, and you must reset the hub's position for this monitor too.

fields.name: gazette_api_url
fields.label: Gazette API address
fields.reason: Only the tests change it. On this page it would let anyone with access send the monitor's requests anywhere, so set it in the hub's .env file.
